g.title: mic_harness
g.text: VERA Mic Harness — Filtered Power, Shielded Signal

g.title: cluster_pwr
g.text: Power Filter Network (mounted at MAX4466 end)

g.title: rules
g.text: 1. Mount C1/C2/C3 within 5 mm of MAX4466 VDD pin (short leads = effective filter).
2. Ferrite bead blocks RF from Pi switching regulator (1–2 MHz harmonics).
3. R_ser + C1 = 100 µs RC time constant → low-pass to remove >1 kHz ripple.
4. Twisted pair rejects common-mode magnetic pickup (50/60 Hz hum).
5. Copper foil shield grounded at ONE end only — Faraday cage, no ground loop.
6. Keep harness away from: servo PWM wires, fan PWM, USB cables, AC adapters.
7. After install: measure noise floor with `arecord -d 5 -f cd silence.wav`,
then `sox silence.wav -n stat` — RMS amplitude should be < 0.001.
